analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($48.85) vs SMA5/20/50 ($46.12/$53.80/$62.03): short-term bullish, mid-term bearish position · SMA100/200 ($68.79/$65.40) position: long-term bearish · 52-week position (22.7%) + current price range near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (32.5→40.7) + exiting oversold, entering neutral zone · MACD histogram trajectory (-0.5416→-0.2641) + improving diagnosis, bearish trend continues · Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $53.80) + band width at 44.39% level
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($48.75) + approaching level · Swing resistance ($51.96) + potential for short-term rebound upon breakout · 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low forming) + recovery signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.41x) + decreased confidence in movement · Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + conditions for entry/wait: RSI stabilization above 50 and MACD golden cross confirmation
